packageRules.description: hashicorp/terraform in scripts/terraform-cli/docker-compose.yml is the LOCAL dev wrapper and must track the version your terraform-plan/terraform-apply CI actions run, not the newest release. Bumping it alone creates terraform fmt divergence between a developer's machine and the CI check. Moving it is a deliberate two-file change (this file + the pinned image), so Renovate does not propose it on its own.

The Ansible controller job in ansible-provision.yml runs ansible-core>=2.16,<2.18, which does not support a Python 3.14 controller (3.10 to 3.12 only). Hold its Python version; moving it is a deliberate change together with the ansible-core constraint. Every other job's python-version is bumped normally.
